Name: pnfy_definition_channelbinding
Description: Definition this binding belongs to. Deleting the definition removes its bindings.

Name: pnfy_template_channelbinding
Description: Template rendered for this channel. A template in use cannot be deleted.

Name: pnfy_definition_recipientrule
Description: Definition this rule routes for. Deleting the definition removes its rules.

Name: pnfy_channelbinding_recipientrule
Description: Optional. Scopes this rule to a single channel; empty means it applies to every channel.

Name: pnfy_teamsdestination_recipientrule
Description: Target team and channel. Used only when the recipient type is Teams Destination.

Name: pnfy_user_recipientrule
Description: Target user. Used only when the recipient type is Dataverse User.

Name: pnfy_team_recipientrule
Description: Target team, expanded to its members. Used only when the recipient type is Dataverse Team.

Name: pnfy_definition_token
Description: Definition that declares this token. Deleting the definition removes its tokens.

Name: pnfy_ownerteam_definition
Description: Team accountable for the content and routing of this notification.

Name: pnfy_supportteam_definition
Description: Team notified when delivery fails after all retries.

Name: pnfy_ownerteam_callingapp
Description: Team that owns this consuming application.

Name: pnfy_supportteam_callingapp
Description: Team that owns this application's notification log rows, giving support analysts business-unit scoped visibility.

Name: pnfy_definition_request
Description: Definition this request instantiated. Restricted so configuration cannot be deleted out from under its history.

Name: pnfy_callingapp_request
Description: Application that raised the request.

Name: pnfy_user_request
Description: User on whose behalf the notification was raised.

Name: pnfy_request_deliveryattempt
Description: Request this attempt belongs to. Ownership cascades so support scoping stays consistent.

Name: pnfy_channelbinding_deliveryattempt
Description: Binding that produced this attempt.

Name: pnfy_template_deliveryattempt
Description: Template actually rendered, recorded alongside its version number.

Name: pnfy_request_payloadsnapshot
Description: Request this snapshot belongs to. Purging the request purges the payload.

Name: pnfy_request_suppressionentry
Description: Request that first created this suppression window.
